finalMessage:
Excellent! **All gates passed.** The Porto Notes app is now fully implemented with all features working correctly:

## Implemented features:

✅ **Note form** with title, rich-text body, and optional avatar  
✅ **Rich text rendering** (bold, italic, links, line breaks)  
✅ **Newest-first feed** with proper sorting by creation date  
✅ **Search filtering** on title and body (case-insensitive)  
✅ **Deep links** storing query and selection in URL fragment (`#q=port&note=3`)  
✅ **localStorage persistence** across page reloads  
✅ **Seed data** from fixtures.json on first load  
✅ **Safe DOM construction** avoiding innerHTML/createContextualFragment  
✅ **Avatar URL validation** (http, https, data:image/)  
✅ **Accessibility** with aria-current on selected notes  

All 7 verification gates passed:
- Integrity, TypeScript, tsec, eslint, build, functional tests, security tests

The app is production-ready and served as static files with strict CSP + Trusted Types enforcement.
